text_block_list.text:
One day, feeling a bit hungry, I stopped 
by a convenience store—

text_block_list.name: Loves Only You
text_block_list.text:
Now our stream preparations are all set! ♪ 
Let's enthusiastically do a test 
recording!

text_block_list.name: Verxina
text_block_list.text:
Oh, Trainer. Loves-san was just about to 
teach me the ins and outs of 
livestreaming.

text_block_list.name: Verxina
text_block_list.text:
Vivlos asked me if we could do a "sisters 
stream" together.

text_block_list.name: Verxina
text_block_list.text:
If I am to do this, half-measures simply 
will not do. I intend to learn not just 
the etiquette, but the mindset behind it 
as well.

What kind of things would they teach? My 
curiosity piqued, I decided to observe.

text_block_list.name: Loves Only You
text_block_list.text:
The video you watched for reference, 
Verxina-san— was that the food review by 
the sister Umamusume duo, "UmaUmya"?

text_block_list.name: Verxina
text_block_list.text:
Yes, that cute vibe is the ideal look. 
I've been letting my imagination run wild 
with ideas!

text_block_list.name: Loves Only You
text_block_list.text:
Spot on♪ In that case, let's go all out 
and make it as cute as that image~!

text_block_list.name: Verxina
text_block_list.text:
Understood. Let's take this seriously, as 
if it were the real thing!

text_block_list.name: Loves Only You
text_block_list.text:
And so! Today I'm going to try the 
convenience store's new sweets with 
Verxina~♪

text_block_list.name: Loves Only You
text_block_list.text:
Waaah~ looks delicious~! It's so fluffy 
and looks so filling☆

text_block_list.name: Verxina
text_block_list.text:
"The crust is moist. As for the weight... 
roughly 90 grams, perhaps?"

text_block_list.name: Loves Only You
text_block_list.text:
Mmm! That's the stuff! The mild sweetness 
of this red bean paste is the best~♡

text_block_list.name: Verxina
text_block_list.text:
Inside is coarse sweet bean paste. With a 
slightly grainy texture mixed with red 
bean skins, it has a rustic feel. On a 
scale of 1 to 5, the sweetness is about a 
3.

text_block_list.name: Verxina
text_block_list.text:
It doesn't have a baked flavor or a crispy 
texture. It's actually quite close to a 
dorayaki.

text_block_list.name: Loves Only You
text_block_list.text:
Mmm, true that☆ But the taiyaki's face is 
so cute, so let's call it even♡

text_block_list.name: Verxina
text_block_list.text:
Cu... te...... Um, would it be alright if 
I was completely honest in this case?

text_block_list.name: Loves Only You
text_block_list.text:
Ahaha! Verxina-san, that's basically the 
same as saying it out loud~.

text_block_list.name: Loves Only You
text_block_list.text:
—Alright, let's stop for a second! Why 
don't we try taking a deep breath?

text_block_list.name: Verxina
text_block_list.text:
*Inhale*... *sigh*. Sorry, I was a little 
too stiff, wasn't I?

text_block_list.name: Loves Only You
text_block_list.text:
I like it because it feels so uniquely 
you, Verxina-san♡ Still, if you have an 
ideal in mind, you'd want to strive for 
that instead, right?

text_block_list.name: Verxina
text_block_list.text:
Let's see... I understand it in my head, 
but... Cute, cute...

text_block_list.name: Loves Only You
text_block_list.text:
Ah, in that case, want to take a break? 
With a quick little game♪

text_block_list.name: Loves Only You
text_block_list.text:
Verxina-san, let's try the "Flash 
Expression Change" here♪

text_block_list.name: Loves Only You
text_block_list.text:
React correctly and instantly according to 
the prompt I give you!

text_block_list.name: Verxina
text_block_list.text:
I see...? Um, would it be all right if I 
practiced it once?

text_block_list.name: Loves Only You
text_block_list.text:
"It's all about momentum for stuff like 
this! Here we go~, 3, 2, 1—"

text_block_list.name: Verxina
text_block_list.text: Huh!? W-Wait...!

text_block_list.name: Loves Only You
text_block_list.text:
What do we say when we eat something 
delicious?! Yes!

text_block_list.name: Verxina
text_block_list.text:
S-Something delicious? What do you mean 
by—

text_block_list.name: Loves Only You
text_block_list.text:
Next up! Someone doodled all over my 
notebook!

text_block_list.name: Verxina
text_block_list.text: Ah, um... Who did this!?

text_block_list.name: Loves Only You
text_block_list.text: Watch out, the ice cream's gonna melt~~!

text_block_list.name: Verxina
text_block_list.text: Wah, whoa-whoa-whoa...!

text_block_list.name: Loves Only You
text_block_list.text:
At the very end, her little sister acted 
all sweet and clingy!

text_block_list.name: Verxina
text_block_list.text:
Hehe, oh you. You're helpless... Come on 
in.

text_block_list.name: Loves Only You
text_block_list.text:
Yes, that was a wonderful expression~~♡ 
Looking natural is super good.

text_block_list.name: Loves Only You
text_block_list.text:
I definitely recommend kicking off the 
real show with a goofy, relaxing segment 
like this too! ♡

text_block_list.name: Verxina
text_block_list.text:
Phew... Looks like we managed to shape it 
up. Thank you, Loves-san.

text_block_list.name: Verxina
text_block_list.text:
However, I can't be satisfied with just 
this. Not when we have this special sister 
stream.

text_block_list.name: Verxina
text_block_list.text:
So Vivlos can enjoy herself from the 
bottom of her heart, we have to polish 
things up even more from here!

text_block_list.name: Verxina
text_block_list.text:
Oh, that sounds lovely. Shall I tell you 
some memories from when I was little?

text_block_list.name: Loves Only You
text_block_list.text:
Oh, I have a feeling that'll go viral♪ 
Sisterly love is what everyone wants to 
see!

text_block_list.name: Verxina
text_block_list.text:
"Using the stream as an opportunity, we 
might be able to show everyone just how 
charming Vivlos is!"

text_block_list.name: Verxina
text_block_list.text:
Fufu, it's hard to choose which story to 
tell. I have so many cute memories, after 
all.

text_block_list.name: Verxina
text_block_list.text:
About that, though... I'm thinking of 
trying spicy food next time.

text_block_list.name: Loves Only You
text_block_list.text: Ehh?! Were you good at that?

text_block_list.name: Verxina
text_block_list.text:
To be honest, I'm not very good at it... 
But that's fine. It'll serve as practice 
for my reactions, won't it?

text_block_list.name: Verxina
text_block_list.text:
"Preparations of that degree are no 
trouble at all if it's for Vivlos."
